decisions.reason: As a core-adjacent upholstery fabric that has survived an initial review and was strongly presented, A likely meets aspiration levels and does not justify reallocating resources away from the established collection.

C fits the firm's contract and hospitality curtain business especially well, and its flame-retardant functionality likely keeps performance above aspiration relative to comparable interior-textile offers.

After two seasons with only limited signaling and a more niche position, E is the most plausible shortfall against aspiration, so a boundedly rational medium-sized textile firm would reassign attention and resources to stronger core lines and new development.
F is still early in its life cycle, has clear fit with both upholstery and curtain uses, and the firm's available slack in a growing market supports keeping it while results become clearer.
